lines.t: Trouble produces endurance, endurance produces character, character produces hope.
There’s a current pushing against me
It feels like it’s always been there
Every step is a constant striving
It seems like more than I can bear
Never resting from the weight I carry
Always having to persevere
If character is built on hard times
If character is built on hard times
I ought to have a lot by now
There’s a pain I carry somewhere deep within
And I don’t know if I’ll ever see it end
Though it may break me, it won’t break my faith
There’s no other way, no other way
You are the waaaayy
While walking through the desert
A ladder was shown in a dream
Reaching from earth into heaven
A glimpse of what’s yet to be
Though for now it’s marked by a stone
I’ll endure this weight till the ladder brings me home
If character is built on hard times
I ought to have a lot by now
There’s a pain I carry somewhere deep within
And I don’t know if I’ll ever see it end
Though it may break me, it won’t break my faith
There’s no other way, no other way
You are the waaaayy
To whom shall I go, Lord?
You have the words of eternal life
I can’t see You through the storm
But I feel Your hand in mine
And somehow I know
I’ll make it through this night
I’ll make it through this night
Oooooohhhhh, ohhhhhhhh

I ought to have a lot by now

And I don’t know if I’ll ever see it end

I don’t know what lies ahead, but I feel Your hand in mine.
I wouldn’t trade Your providence for anything in the world…
Your hand, Your hand in mine.
